preflight.r0_blocker: EV computation = 0 - IL - gas - rebalance - opportunity = 0 (r0 算不出, 因 fee=0, IL=null, gas=0, rebalance=0)

watchlist.criteria: basic pool meta + recent fee trend + TVL trend
watchlist.r0_blocker: fee trend = 0 × 12 ckpt = 0; TVL trend = static (因 reserve=0)

data_insufficient.r0_state: 53 池 r0 全部 data layer = 0/null/placeholder
data_insufficient.spec_clarification: DATA_INSUFFICIENT ≠ REJECT_BY_EV; DATA_INSUFFICIENT = 等 r1; REJECT_BY_EV = 有 data 算 EV<=0

reject.r0_blocker: tier classifier DEFERRED_TO_R1; tier_c_assigned=false; hard rejection 不 applied

important_disclaimers: 53 池**不**是 'EV <= 0, 拒绝' (因 r0 算不出 EV)
53 池**不**是 'tier_c hard reject' (因 r0 算不出 tier)
53 池**不**是 'fee 太低, 拒绝' (因 r0 fee=0 是 placeholder, **不**是 actual)
53 池**不**是 'IL 太高, 拒绝' (因 r0 IL=null)
53 池**不**是 'tick out of range, 拒绝' (因 r0 tick=null)
53 池**是** '**没有** data, **不能**做 LP 决策, 暂搁置等 r1'
spec: '**不得** 把 DATA_INSUFFICIENT 解读成 不值得参与'

global_lp_rejected_explanation.means: 12h 跑通后, LP 全局**被**拒绝
false_means: LP rejected 仅在: freeze reopened + r1 actual data + preflight all reject by EV (≥ N ckpt)
当前 3 个条件**全部** false → global_lp_rejected = false
false **不**意味着 LP 可以; false 仅指 '未做 global reject 决定'
实际 LP **不**可进 (freeze + r0 + data insufficient), 但**理由**是 'blocked by r1 + freeze', **不**是 'global reject'

candidate_decision_reliable_explanation.means: candidate review 决策**是**否 reliable (有 data, 可信)
false_means: preflight=0, watchlist=0, reject=0 → 'no decision' 状态
r0 data layer = 0 → 'no data to base decision on'
任何'53 池参与'或'53 池不参与'决策 = unreliable (因无 data)
candidate_decision_reliable = false **不**意味着 'reject by unreliable', 是 '**不**做 candidate 决策, 等 r1'

全部 4 个 component 不足 → tier 分类**不** applied → DEFERRED_TO_R1
